subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this grouped Claw manifest and gated read-only CLI as the canonical base for the RFC 0016 lifecycle stack?
rationale: The implementation creates a new package/configuration contract and CLI namespace with multiple dependent PRs; correctness review cannot decide whether that long-lived product surface should become core while the RFC remains open.

options.title: Approve after cleanup
options.body: Approve the grouped contract in RFC 0016, remove the duplicate parsers, rebase, and complete exact-head validation before merging this base PR.

options.title: Hold for RFC revision
options.body: Keep the stack open but pause implementation review until maintainers settle outstanding schema, ownership, and lifecycle choices in the RFC.

options.title: Decline the core surface
options.body: Reject the Claws core direction and close the dependent stack rather than maintaining an experimental parallel package lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Approve after cleanup
recommendation.body: Approve the grouped contract in RFC 0016, remove the duplicate parsers, rebase, and complete exact-head validation before merging this base PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the deepest current contract review across the affected owner boundaries, although final product authority may require another repository owner.
